drivingQuestion: Do R' Yehuda and R' Yishmael in fact hold one view about the status of a bird's down?
outcomeNote: Rava's distinction stands unanswered; R' Yoḥanan's equation of the two tannaim is left blocked.

segments.he: אָמַר רָבָא: דִּילְמָא לָא הִיא, עַד כָּאן לָא קָאָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה הָכָא אֶלָּא לְעִנְיַן טְרֵפָה, דְּלֵיכָּא מִידֵּי דְּמַגֵּין עֲלֵיהּ, אֲבָל לְעִנְיַן אִיפַּגּוֹלֵי – כְּרַבָּנַן סְבִירָא לֵיהּ, וְעַד כָּאן לָא קָאָמַר רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל הָתָם אֶלָּא לְעִנְיַן אִיפַּגּוֹלֵי, אֲבָל לְעִנְיַן טְרֵפָה – אַגּוֹנֵי לָא מַגֵּין.
segments.en: «Rava said: Perhaps it is not so,» and they disagree. Perhaps «Rabbi Yehuda says» that the down is like the hide of an animal «here only with regard to a tereifa, since» when the down is removed, «there is nothing that protects» the bird, and its life is in danger; «but with regard to piggul, he holds in accordance with» the opinion of «the Rabbis» that the down is not treated like the hide of an animal, because piggul applies only if one had intent to consume an item that is normally consumed. «And» perhaps «Rabbi Yishmael says» so «there only with regard to piggul,» since he holds that the down is in fact fit for consumption; «but with regard to a tereifa,» he holds that the down «does not protect» the bird, and its removal does not endanger it.

moves.summary: Rava denies that the two tannaim's rulings express one principle
moves.about: whether R' Yehuda and R' Yishmael really hold one view about the status of a bird's down

moves.cueHe: עד כאן לא קאמר רבי יהודה הכא אלא לענין טרפה
moves.summary: each tanna spoke only for his own domain — R' Yehuda for tereifa, R' Yishmael for piggul — and in the other each holds with his opponents
moves.about: confining R' Yehuda's ruling to tereifa, where the removed down leaves nothing protecting the bird, and denying that he holds it for piggul
